Couldn't hold temp, wasted charcoal because it wasn't sealed enough to put the coals out,  and was literally falling apart after only 7 years! Results.ReviewText:
Love, LOVE this grill. I have the Copper 22 inch kettle and it is magnificent. The Copper color is just about he most attractive coloring I've ever seen on a grill. Dampers work well to control temp. I look forward to putting this kettle through it's paces soon and see how it performs smoking. I have no doubt that with some vigilance on my part it will pass with flying colors.

Assembly was easy and once completed grill seems sturdy and solid. It took me about 2.5 cooks to get the hang (develop the muscle memory) of having the lid off of the grill with the interior hook but now that I have it works flawlessly.  Grill space is more than ample. Ash cleaning system is simple, elegant and effective - I love it!.

The only relatively minor complaint I have is that the hooks on the front handle to hold tools seem a bit close to the kettle itself.  Tongs, spatulas and whatnot can tend to get somewhat uncomfortably hot when running hotter fires in the kettle (steaks etc.) Not a huge issue, doesn't make me love my kettle any less but it might me nice to have a heat shield on the front handle like the one on the top of the lid to combat this.

All in all, I could not be more pleased with this grill.  I look forward to many years of dependable service and accumulating some add-on accessories to expand it's capabilities.

14407001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14407001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty

14402001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
